name: click-type
title: Click Type
description: Click to type: a prompt composer (Prompt Send's glass panel, writing surface and round send button) whose placeholder writes itself while a cursor flies in from the edge and clicks the field, then a hard cut into the field where the real prompt types at the caret and send arms. Two shots of one composer under a constant camera, anchored on the first letter, so the type never scales while it moves. Built on cursor-track.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/cursor/click-type?ref=cli — placeholder writes itself in the wide shot; prompt is what types after the click, in the close-up. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 76 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
